rules.description: Checks that the percentage of deleted points is within the threshold.
Verifies that active Monthly TotalEnergy StatVars have observations within 1 year of the current year and active Annual StatVars are within 2 years.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate FROM stats WHERE NOT regexp_matches(StatVar, '^eia/TOTAL\.(((AV|D2|DS|JK|KS|MG|PR|RB|RF|RO)(TCU|WHU)|CLRC[BEP]|D2RC[AO]|BOIMP|COQIP|ESOTU|GEC9S|HPC9S|NGWPU|OGWSP|RLUCU)\.[AM]|GEC9P\.M|NGVHU\.A)$')
params.condition: CAST(SUBSTR(MaxDate, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - CASE WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, '(\.M$|^Monthly_)') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END

rules.description: Verifies the generated output CSV data matches established critical golden records
